items.title: Base change for the pushforward along an integral morphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves base change for the pushforward along an integral morphism: for a cartesian square with f integral and any sheaf of sets on X_etale, the pushforward of the pullback equals the pullback of the pushforward (statement lines 8349-8361). The proof localises on Y and uses integrality to reduce to the affine case (proof lines 8363-8375), where both sides are computed through the sections over the base change (proof lines 8375-8395), and then descends the local computation (proof lines 8395-8404). The non-formal content is the affine computation where integrality is used to make the schemes affine. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one affine computation.
